office_does: The Treasurer collects property taxes and holds and invests the money of the county and its junior taxing districts (schools, ports, fire districts).
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Debra Gardner (prefers Independent), in office eight years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Cowlitz County Treasurer for eight years (prefers Independent), seeking another term; the only candidate.
highlights: Treasurer for the last eight years [S1]
Launched the Cowlitz County Investment Pool to raise interest earnings [S1]
Added fraud-prevention measures for the county and its junior taxing districts [S1]
